docs.summary: Represents a 3D transformation matrix. Provides a rich API for manipulating position, rotation, and scale, suitable for 3D object transformations.
A transform with default values (position 0, no rotation, scale 1).
The position of the transform in 3D space.
The rotation of the transform as a standard float-based quaternion.
The scale of the transform.

members.name: Transform3D
members.signature: public Transform3D(Float3 position, Quaternion rotation, Float3 scale)

docs.summary: Initializes a new transform with specified position, rotation, and scale.
The rotation as Euler angles in degrees (order ZYXr). This is useful for inspector UIs and simple rotational adjustments.
The forward direction of this transform (+Z axis in local space).
The up direction of this transform (+Y axis in local space).
The right direction of this transform (+X axis in local space).
Transforms a point from local space to world space.
Transforms a point from world space to local space.
Transforms a direction from local space to world space (unaffected by scale or position).
Transforms a direction from world space to local space (unaffected by scale or position).
Transforms a vector from local space to world space (affected by rotation and scale, but not position).
Transforms a vector from world space to local space (affected by rotation and scale, but not position).
